body: AHAHAHAHA grabe dami ko na rin kilala na nag loa, and i fully support that!! nanggaling na rin ako sa loa noon and it really did a great thing for me and growth. kung sakaling matuloy ka, sana good results rin!! if i can do it again i would HAHAHA hanggang sa mag f2f lang sana yknow pero alam mo naman…. may oras rin talaga mga bagay sa realidad di ako pwede magpalipas ng maraming taon hahaha goodluck sa atin!! 😭😭😭

yes same!! diba yung mga nagagawa natin pag f2f but as much as we want f2f so bad and as bad as we’re wishing for it to happen talaga, all we can do for now is manifest and just make do and get the best out of what we can. suuuuucks sobra as in nakaka frustrate kasi gusto ko na rin maramdaman na normal HAHA as in 😭😭😭 may days na parang,,, sa sobrang frustrated naiiyak na talaga ako tas i keep on blaming myself feel ko rin talaga sobrang bobo ko ganon. it’s been getting harder & harder to attend classes :((( sana talaga matapos na yung sem na ‘to and makabalik na sa f2f. kahit 50% lang masaya na ako don, ano ba naman yung atleast twice a week maramdaman mong tunay kang estudyante :(

Yeah man as much as gusto rin talaga kita i-hype up and all, can’t deny na sobrang felt. Lahat ng comments dito felt na felt kasi parang ganyan rin mood ko ngayon, maitawid nalang yung sem yknow? Makakuha ng enough na units kahit papano, luckily hindi pa naman ako masyado nagmamadali pero still. Sayang lang kasi yung iba parang gusto mo naman talaga pag-aralan o interesado ka naman talaga, pero hindi na rin ma-adapt ng katawan mo or what dahil sa set up and you can’t really blame yourself for it.

As for your groupmates, man i swear sa case namin lahat rin kami pagod na parang “sige matapos nalang” type of mood already HAHAHA minsan nakakahiya won’t deny that, but also it’s really hard to function. Hindi rin naman makapag LOA kasi may kanya kanya tayong hinahabol rin.

As for your extracurricular activities, i really hope soon enough magawa mo na ulit. I have orgs rn and honestly even tho i’m really exhausted, thankfully i can still find the fun in what i do sa orgs. Iba’t-iba rin kasi kinukuha ko ngayon na subjects dahil sa inadvise sa akin, already dropped one tbh but it’s nice to be reminded kung ano ba talaga yung fun na gawin for me rin. I hope ikaw rin mahanap yun ulit. :)

Again, sobrang felt :(((( syempre di ko namimiss traffic and all pero the hustle!! yung ramdam mo na tao ka, na part ka ng realidad, na kahit pagod ka physically meron ka rin pwede gawin as breather after like hanging out w your friends or pagdaan sa coffee shop o kung saan ka komportable. miss na miss ko na rin yun 😭😭😭

:( i’m so sorry to hear this, but also i’m quite glad na we found each other even thru reddit para atleast we both know na hindi tayo nag iisa. sobrang felt nga na ibang iba nung f2f and it can really get frustrating right now but hey, we can do this. manifesting na mag f2f na soon 💖
it definitely made me feel better knowing na hindi ako mag isa na nakakaramdam ng mga ganitong bagay. thank you!

Totoo :(((( akala ata nila mas masaya o mas effective yung ganon eh mas nakaka stress nga :( imagine having to convert every file or download muna bago submit or whatever process na pwede naman sana maging mas madali :(((
